problem: PR #625 made EntityOS optional at Docker build time, but normal service startup still required a non-empty EntityOS SHA-256 and verified artifact. A baseline image with ENTITYOS_SHA256 empty would therefore fail before normal runtime readiness.

contract: EntityOS absent plus execution disabled returns staged=false, verified=false, execution_enabled=false
execution enabled without SHA-256 fails closed
unpinned regular-file bytes fail closed even when execution is disabled
pinned EntityOS remains verified but is not exposed as an execution bridge when execution is disabled
pinned verified EntityOS bridge is exposed only when execution is enabled
